The visit

What the diagnostic covers.

The $89 diagnostic is credited toward the repair. It is a sealed-system test, not a look at the door seal.

  • Model and serial plate matched to the parts diagram
  • Sealed-system pressures and cabinet temperatures logged
  • Defrost cycle and evaporator fan checked
  • Installation checked for airflow, level and door alignment

If a factory part is backordered, you get the part number, the price and the ETA before we leave.

Book a diagnostic

Common Sub-Zero faults

Seven faults cover
most Sub-Zero call-outs.

If yours is on the list, the part is usually already on the van. The price is confirmed before anything is ordered.

  • Not cooling

    Compressor start components, evaporator fan or a defrost failure. Sealed-system pressures are logged before the quote.

  • Freezer not freezing

    Defrost heater, thermistor or the air damper. Tested at temperature before we leave.

  • Frost on the back wall

    Defrost heater or timer. Frost across the back wall usually means the heater.

  • Ice maker stopped

    Water inlet valve, filter or the ice-maker module. Line flushed and tested on the same visit.

  • Water on the floor

    Blocked drain line, cracked defrost trough or a split door gasket. Floor dried and checked before we go.

  • Running all the time

    Blocked condenser coils, a tired fan motor or a compressor losing pressure. Coils cleaned first.

  • Wine storage running warm

    Thermistor, evaporator fan or condenser airflow. Temperature held and logged before we leave.

How the visit works

One fee, one price,
before the work starts.

No factory part is ordered and no work is billed until you approve the number on the invoice.

  1. Model and serial on the phone

    Read the plate inside the cabinet when you call. We check the parts diagram before the visit, so the van leaves with the right part.

  2. Sealed-system diagnostic

    Pressures, temperatures and the defrost cycle are tested on site. The $89 diagnostic is credited toward the repair.

  3. Price approved

    You get the repair price before anything is ordered. Backordered parts come with a part number, a price and an ETA.

  4. Repair and warranty

    Most refrigeration repairs finish on the first visit. Parts and labor are covered for 90 days, written on the invoice.
